# Capability map

<!-- Generated by npm run capabilities from plugins/genobi/capabilities.json. Do not edit; change the JSON. -->

What Genobi can do, one feature at a time: 58 features, 21 verified, 34 implemented, 3 planned. Each says where it is in the studio, where it runs and on which models, the MCP tools, CLI verbs and skills that drive it, and the docs behind it.

The page is rendered from [`plugins/genobi/capabilities.json`](https://github.com/koshimazaki/Genobi/blob/main/plugins/genobi/capabilities.json), which ships with the plugin. An agent asked "what can I do here?" reads that file: `genobi capabilities` prints it, and an MCP-only agent reads it beside `registry.json` in the plugin folder. [The registry](registry.md) lists the same tools and skills by tag. `npm run check:capabilities` fails when a registry tool or skill is in no feature, a tool, skill or doc does not exist, a verified feature has no dated record, or this page is stale.

## Status

- **verified** (21): A docs page, run card or workflow README records it working on a date; evidence is that date and section.
- **implemented** (34): Built and covered by tests, with no dated record of a real run yet.
- **planned** (3): Specified in the docs, not built.

A verified feature links the dated record that shows it working. Local evidence and deployed behaviour are told apart in that record, not here.

## Weights

Each model in a route says whether that route runs open weights. Open Weights Only counts the `open` routes alone.

- **open**: The route runs the published weights, on this machine or on Comfy, so anyone can download and run them.
- **closed**: The weights are not published; the model is reached only through its provider's API.
- **api**: The route calls a provider's hosted API, so it runs no weights of ours, even where the model's weights are published elsewhere.

A two-minute mix of the studio in use cut to a 135 BPM track: 4K studio footage with camera moves, Transitions.dev titles, Paper Shaders and a taste-layer credit; nothing to generate, opens as editable lanes.

### Takes from a terminal or an agent in the gallery

A take the genobi command or an MCP client quoted and submitted shows in the studio's gallery once Ready, marked with where it came from; the studio plays it, recreates it and sends it to the Director's assets.

- **Where:** Gallery · cards marked From terminal or From agent, on the local server · **Runs:** Local, free · **Status:** implemented
- **MCP tools:** [`genobi_quote`](registry-tools.md#genobi_quote), [`genobi_submit`](registry-tools.md#genobi_submit) · **CLI:** `genobi quote`, `genobi submit` · **Skills:** [`genobi-cli`](registry-skills.md#genobi-cli) · **Docs:** [genobi-cli.md](genobi-cli.md), [project-assets.md](project-assets.md)

### Run location and workflow swap

Choose local ComfyUI, Comfy Cloud, or a registered Comfy deployment for open workflows, and swap the graph behind a model for the session. Runtime discovery distinguishes hosted support from local configuration.

### Openjutsu character swap with a Klein first frame

Swap the person in a 5 to 15 second part of a clip; Genobi makes the first frame with a Klein box edit, so a box can change a whole person or one item.

- **Where:** Comfy · npm run swap or an agent's quote (local studio only) · **Runs:** Comfy Cloud: MiniMax H3 (Comfy workflow) (open weights), H3 character swap LoRA with SAM 3.1 (open weights) · Paid API: FLUX 3 Image Klein on BFL's API (API) · **Status:** implemented
- **MCP tools:** [`genobi_quote`](registry-tools.md#genobi_quote), [`genobi_submit`](registry-tools.md#genobi_submit), [`genobi_media_trim`](registry-tools.md#genobi_media_trim) · **CLI:** `genobi quote`, `genobi submit`, `genobi media-trim` · **Skills:** none · **Docs:** [openjutsu-swap.md](openjutsu-swap.md), [comfy-deployment.md](comfy-deployment.md)
